<h1 id="集群的核心逻辑">集群的核心逻辑</h1>
<p>ThingsBoard 微服务是Kafka + ZooKeeper + 多节点 对等集群的架构</p>
<p>[[N_ThingsBoard]]<br>
[[N_ThingsBoard 集群的消息处理源码分析]]<br>
[[N_ZooKeepper学习一则]]</p>
<h2 id="集群角色划分">集群角色划分</h2>
<p><strong>整体角色划分</strong></p>
<div class="mermaid">flowchart TD    
  subgraph ZK["ZooKeeper — 服务注册与发现"]
	  zkNode["/thingsboard/nodes/&lt;br/&gt;├ node0..01 (tb-core)&lt;br/&gt;├ node0..02 (tb-rule-engine)&lt;br/&gt;└ node0..03 (tb-core)"]
  end

  subgraph ServiceNodes["服务节点 (每个 JVM 进程)"]
	  N1["tb-core 节点 A&lt;br/&gt;ZkDiscoveryService&lt;br/&gt;HashPartitionService"]
	  N2["tb-rule-engine 节点 B&lt;br/&gt;ZkDiscoveryService&lt;br/&gt;HashPartitionService"]
	  N3["tb-core 节点 C&lt;br/&gt;ZkDiscoveryService&lt;br/&gt;HashPartitionService"]
  end

  subgraph Kafka["Apache Kafka — 消息总线"]
	  T1["tb_core&lt;br/&gt;partition-0 .. partition-9"]
	  T2["tb_rule_engine.Main&lt;br/&gt;partition-0 .. partition-9"]
	  T3["tb_rule_engine.HighPriority&lt;br/&gt;partition-0 .. partition-4"]
  end

  N1 --&gt;|"EPHEMERAL 节点注册"| zkNode
  N2 --&gt;|"EPHEMERAL 节点注册"| zkNode
  N3 --&gt;|"EPHEMERAL 节点注册"| zkNode

  zkNode --&gt;|"PathChildrenCache 监听"| N1
  zkNode --&gt;|"PathChildrenCache 监听"| N2
  zkNode --&gt;|"PathChildrenCache 监听"| N3

  N1 --&gt;|"消费 [0,2,4,6,8]"| T1
  N3 --&gt;|"消费 [1,3,5,7,9]"| T1
  N2 --&gt;|"消费所有分区"| T2

<td style="text-align: left"><code>HashPartitionService</code></td>
</tr>

<h2 id="一-zookeeper-注册中心">一. ZooKeeper 注册中心</h2>
<h3 id="初始化客户端"><strong>初始化客户端</strong></h3>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#initZkClient</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">private void initZkClient() {
	try {
		// CuratorFramework 客户端
		client = CuratorFrameworkFactory.newClient(zkUrl, zkSessionTimeout, zkConnectionTimeout, new RetryForever(zkRetryInterval));
		client.start();
		client.blockUntilConnected();
		// PathChildrenCache , 用于监听 zkNodesDir 下所有子节点的增删改事件。
		//ThingsBoard 用它来感知集群中其他服务节点的上线/下线, 实现服务发现。 后续 subscribeToEvents() 再将this（当前类）注册为事件监听器, 当子节点变化时触发回调处理集群拓扑变更。
		cache = new PathChildrenCache(client, zkNodesDir, true);
		cache.start();
		stopped = false;
		log.info("ZK client connected");
	} catch (Exception e) {
		log.error("Failed to connect to ZK: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
		CloseableUtils.closeQuietly(cache);
		CloseableUtils.closeQuietly(client);
		throw new RuntimeException(e);
	}
}
</code></pre>
<p>关于 zoo 的节点路径:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">//在配置
zk_dir: "${ZOOKEEPER_NODES_DIR:/thingsboard}"

// init()
zkNodesDir = zkDir + "/nodes";   // → "/thingsboard/nodes/0...01"

// publishCurrentServer()
nodePath = client.create()
  .creatingParentsIfNeeded()
  .withMode(CreateMode.EPHEMERAL_SEQUENTIAL)   // 临时顺序节点
  .forPath(zkNodesDir + "/", self.toByteArray());
</code></pre>
<h3 id="注册自己订阅事件"><strong>注册自己&amp;订阅事件</strong></h3>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#onApplicationEvent</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@AfterStartUp(order = AfterStartUp.DISCOVERY_SERVICE)
public void onApplicationEvent(ApplicationReadyEvent event) {
	if (stopped) {
		log.debug("Ignoring application ready event. Service is stopped.");
		return;
	} else {
		log.info("Received application ready event. Starting current ZK node.");
	}
	//1. 注意先订阅
	subscribeToEvents();
	if (client.getState() != CuratorFrameworkState.STARTED) {
		log.debug("Ignoring application ready event, ZK client is not started, ZK client state [{}]", client.getState());
		return;
	}
	log.info("Going to publish current server...");
	//2. 向 zookeeper 注册
	publishCurrentServer();
	log.info("Going to recalculate partitions...");
	recalculatePartitions();
	//3. 周期性 更新和检查是否注册到 zookeeper中
	zkExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::publishCurrentServer, 1, 1, TimeUnit.MINUTES);
}


private void subscribeToEvents() { 
	//监听节点事件
    cache.getListenable().addListener(this);  
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#publishCurrentServer</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@SneakyThrows
public synchronized void publishCurrentServer() {
	//自己的服务信息
	TransportProtos.ServiceInfo self = serviceInfoProvider.getServiceInfo();
	// 节点不存在则创建, 存在则更新数据
	if (currentServerExists()) {
		log.trace("[{}] Updating ZK node for current instance: {}", self.getServiceId(), nodePath);
		//更新
		client.setData().forPath(nodePath, serviceInfoProvider.generateNewServiceInfoWithCurrentSystemInfo().toByteArray());
	} else {
		try {
			log.info("[{}] Creating ZK node for current instance", self.getServiceId());
			// 创建节点(临时)
			nodePath = client.create()
					.creatingParentsIfNeeded()
					.withMode(CreateMode.EPHEMERAL_SEQUENTIAL).forPath(zkNodesDir + "/", self.toByteArray());
			log.info("[{}] Created ZK node for current instance: {}", self.getServiceId(), nodePath);
			client.getConnectionStateListenable().addListener(checkReconnect(self));
		} catch (Exception e) {
			log.error("Failed to create ZK node", e);
			throw new RuntimeException(e);
		}
	}
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="注册的服务类型">注册的服务类型?</h4>
<p><strong>将自己注册为什么服务类型, 取决于序列化到 zookeeper 中的 ServiceInfo 信息, 所以找ServiceInfo生成的逻辑</strong></p>
<p>生成 ServiceInfo 的方法</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
public ServiceInfo generateNewServiceInfoWithCurrentSystemInfo() {
	ServiceInfo.Builder builder = ServiceInfo.newBuilder()
			.setServiceId(serviceId)
			//重点在这里
			.addAllServiceTypes(serviceTypes.stream().map(ServiceType::name).collect(Collectors.toList()))
			.setSystemInfo(getCurrentSystemInfoProto());
	if (CollectionsUtil.isNotEmpty(assignedTenantProfiles)) {
		builder.addAllAssignedTenantProfiles(assignedTenantProfiles.stream().map(UUID::toString).collect(Collectors.toList()));
	}
	if (edqsConfig != null) {
		builder.setLabel(edqsConfig.getLabel());
	}
	builder.setReady(ready);
	builder.addAllTaskTypes(taskTypes.stream().map(JobType::name).toList());
	return serviceInfo = builder.build();
}
</code></pre>
<p>再见 <code>init</code> 方法<br>
<code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.DefaultTbServiceInfoProvider#init</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostConstruct
public void init() {
	if (StringUtils.isEmpty(serviceId)) {
		try {
			serviceId = InetAddress.getLocalHost().getHostName();
		} catch (UnknownHostException e) {
			serviceId = StringUtils.randomAlphabetic(10);
		}
	}
	log.info("Current Service ID: {}", serviceId);
	//当前节点的服务信息初始化
	serviceTypes = isMonolith() ?
			List.of(ServiceType.values()) :
			Collections.singletonList(ServiceType.of(serviceType));
	if (!serviceTypes.contains(ServiceType.TB_RULE_ENGINE) || assignedTenantProfiles == null) {
		assignedTenantProfiles = Collections.emptySet();
	}
	if (serviceTypes.contains(ServiceType.EDQS)) {
		ready = false;
		if (StringUtils.isBlank(edqsConfig.getLabel())) {
			edqsConfig.setLabel(serviceId);
		}
	}
	if (CollectionsUtil.isNotEmpty(availableTaskProcessors)) {
		taskTypes = availableTaskProcessors.stream()
				.map(TaskProcessor::getJobType)
				.toList();
	} else {
		taskTypes = Collections.emptyList();
	}

	generateNewServiceInfoWithCurrentSystemInfo();
}
</code></pre>
<p>得看 serviceType 的配置</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">// @Value("${service.type:monolith}")  ← 从配置读, 默认 monolith
private String serviceType;

// init() 中：
serviceTypes = isMonolith()
  ? List.of(ServiceType.values())                          // monolith: 全类型
  : Collections.singletonList(ServiceType.of(serviceType)); // 微服务: 单类型

//ServiceType.of() 做了一次转换：把配置字符串 tb-core → TB_CORE（替换 - 为 _ 再 toUpperCase）。

</code></pre>
<p>其他节点通过读这个 serviceTypesList 字段决定把哪些分区路由给谁, 就是  <code>HashPartitionService.addNode() </code>里按 serviceType 分组的逻辑。</p>
<h4 id="集群的所有类型">集群的所有类型</h4>
<p>见 <code>org.thingsboard.server.common.msg.queue.ServiceType</code> 的枚举值</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RequiredArgsConstructor  
@Getter  
public enum ServiceType {  
  
    TB_CORE("TB Core"),  
    TB_RULE_ENGINE("TB Rule Engine"),  
    TB_TRANSPORT("TB Transport"),  
    JS_EXECUTOR("JS Executor"),  
    TB_VC_EXECUTOR("TB VC Executor"),  
    EDQS("TB Entity Data Query Service"),  
    TASK_PROCESSOR("Task Processor");  
  
    private final String label;  
  
    public static ServiceType of(String serviceType) {  
        return ServiceType.valueOf(serviceType.replace("-", "_").toUpperCase());  
    }  
  
}
</code></pre>

<p>见<code>HashPartitionService</code> 中:<br>
<code>TB_CORE</code>、<code>TB_RULE_ENGINE</code>、<code>TB_VC_EXECUTOR</code>、<code>EDQS</code>、<code>TASK_PROCESSOR</code> 都有对应的 <code>partitionSizesMap</code> 和 <code>partitionTopicsMap</code> 条目参与分区计算；<br>
<code>TB_TRANSPORT</code> 和 <code>JS_EXECUTOR</code> 本身不消费分区，但会被其他服务感知到用于路由决策。</p>
<h3 id="集群变更时">集群变更时</h3>
<p><strong>其实就是在节点增删改时..</strong></p>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.ZkDiscoveryService#childEvent</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">/**
 * ZK 子节点变化回调（PathChildrenCacheListener 实现）。
 * 节点上线（`CHILD_ADDED`）时立即触发分区重算；
 * 节点下线（CHILD_REMOVED）时延迟重算, 留出时间窗口让服务重启后取消重算, 避免分区抖动。
 */
@Override
public void childEvent(CuratorFramework curatorFramework, PathChildrenCacheEvent pathChildrenCacheEvent) throws Exception {
	// 服务已停止或 ZK 客户端未就绪时忽略所有事件
	if (stopped) {
		log.debug("Ignoring {}. Service is stopped.", pathChildrenCacheEvent);
		return;
	}
	// ZK client 没准备好, 忽略..
	if (client.getState() != CuratorFrameworkState.STARTED) {
		log.debug("Ignoring {}, ZK client is not started, ZK client state [{}]", pathChildrenCacheEvent, client.getState());
		return;
	}
	// 事件携带的节点数据为空时忽略（初始化阶段偶发）
	ChildData data = pathChildrenCacheEvent.getData();
	if (data == null) {
		log.debug("Ignoring {} due to empty child data", pathChildrenCacheEvent);
		return;
	} else if (data.getData() == null) {
		log.debug("Ignoring {} due to empty child's data", pathChildrenCacheEvent);
		return;
	} else if (nodePath != null &amp;&amp; nodePath.equals(data.getPath())) {
		// 事件来自当前节点自身：若被意外删除则立即重新注册, 其余事件忽略
		if (pathChildrenCacheEvent.getType() == CHILD_REMOVED) {
			log.info("ZK node for current instance is somehow deleted.");
			publishCurrentServer();
		}
		log.debug("Ignoring event about current server {}", pathChildrenCacheEvent);
		return;
	}
	// 将节点的字节数据反序列化为 ServiceInfo（Protobuf）
	TransportProtos.ServiceInfo instance;
	try {
		instance = TransportProtos.ServiceInfo.parseFrom(data.getData());
	} catch (InvalidProtocolBufferException e) {
		log.error("Failed to decode server instance for node {}", data.getPath(), e);
		throw e;
	}

	String serviceId = instance.getServiceId();
	ProtocolStringList serviceTypesList = instance.getServiceTypesList();

	log.trace("Processing [{}] event for [{}]", pathChildrenCacheEvent.getType(), serviceId);
	switch (pathChildrenCacheEvent.getType()) {
		case CHILD_ADDED:
			// 节点上线：检查 delayedTasks 中是否存在该服务的延迟重算任务
			// （服务重启时会先触发 CHILD_REMOVED 再触发 CHILD_ADDED, 若能在窗口内取消则跳过重算）
			ScheduledFuture&lt;?&gt; task = delayedTasks.remove(serviceId);
			if (task != null) {
				if (task.cancel(false)) {
					// 延迟任务取消成功：服务在时间窗口内完成重启, 无需重算分区
					log.info("[{}] Recalculate partitions ignored. Service was restarted in time [{}].",
							serviceId, serviceTypesList);
				} else {
					// 延迟任务已执行：重算已发生, 此处补一次确保状态最终一致
					log.debug("[{}] Going to recalculate partitions. Service was not restarted in time [{}]!",
							serviceId, serviceTypesList);
					recalculatePartitions();
				}
			} else {
				// 全新节点上线, 直接触发分区重算
				log.trace("[{}] Going to recalculate partitions due to adding new node [{}].",
						serviceId, serviceTypesList);
				recalculatePartitions();
			}
			break;
		case CHILD_REMOVED:
			// 节点下线：立即发布 OtherServiceShutdownEvent 通知其他组件
			zkExecutorService.submit(() -&gt; applicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(new OtherServiceShutdownEvent(this, serviceId, serviceTypesList)));
			// 延迟触发分区重算, 给服务留出重启时间；若 CHILD_ADDED 在窗口内到来则取消此任务
			ScheduledFuture&lt;?&gt; future = zkExecutorService.schedule(() -&gt; {
				log.debug("[{}] Going to recalculate partitions due to removed node [{}]",
						serviceId, serviceTypesList);
				ScheduledFuture&lt;?&gt; removedTask = delayedTasks.remove(serviceId);
				if (removedTask != null) {
					recalculatePartitions();
				}
			}, recalculateDelay, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
			delayedTasks.put(serviceId, future);
			break;
		default:
			break;
	}
}
</code></pre>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>事件</th>
<th>处理逻辑</th>
<th>目的</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>CHILD_ADDED</td>
<td>立即 recalculatePartitions</td>
<td>新节点上线, 重新分配分区</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CHILD_REMOVED</td>
<td>延迟 recalculateDelay ms 后重算</td>
<td>防抖：服务重启时先下线再上线, 若在时间窗口内重新注册则取消重算, 避免不必要的分区抖动</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CHILD_REMOVED（自身节点）</td>
<td>重新 publishCurrentServer</td>
<td>如果是自己, 则是被意外删除则立即重新注册</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.HashPartitionService#recalculatePartitions</code> 是最终分区计算出口, 每次节点变化时调用没, 根据当前所有在线节点重新计算消息队列的分区分配。见: 三. HashPartitionService 队列分区计算</td>
<td></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="二-kafka-消息队列">二. Kafka 消息队列</h2>
<p>[[N_Kafka]]</p>
<p>首先集群中每个节点使用 Kafka 消息队列进行通信, 核心问题是</p>
<ol>
<li>集群中: 每个角色都使用哪些生产者和消费者?</li>
<li>整体项目, 有哪些队列通道(Topic),  生产者, 消费者?</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="初始化-producerprovider-集群角色使用了哪些生产者">初始化 ProducerProvider (集群角色使用了哪些生产者?)</h3>
<p><strong>首先 TB 模块项目中使用 TbQueueProducerProvider 接口来获取生产者对象.</strong></p>
<p>该接口有4个实现的 <code>ProducerProvider</code> 见下:</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>实现类</th>
<th>激活条件</th>
<th>对应微服务</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>TbCoreQueueProducerProvider</code></td>
<td><code>@TbCoreComponent</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>service.type == monolith 或 tb-core</code></td>
<td>tb-core</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>TbRuleEngineProducerProvider</code></td>
<td><code>@ConditionalOnExpression</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>service.type == tb-rule-engine</code></td>
<td>tb-rule-engine</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>TbTransportQueueProducerProvider</code></td>
<td><code>@ConditionalOnExpression</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>service.type == tb-transport</code></td>
<td>tb-transport</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>TbVersionControlProducerProvider</code></td>
<td><code>@ConditionalOnExpression</code>&nbsp;→&nbsp;<code>service.type == tb-vc-executor</code></td>

<h4 id="tbcorequeuefactory-委托给-factory实际创建-producer">TbCoreQueueFactory 委托给 Factory实际创建 Producer</h4>
<p>以 core 为例, 其最终创建注入的 TbCoreQueueFactory 取决于配置(集群, 单体, 单体+使用了kafka):</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Service
@TbCoreComponent
public class TbCoreQueueProducerProvider implements TbQueueProducerProvider {

    private final TbCoreQueueFactory tbQueueProvider;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToTransportMsg&gt;&gt; toTransport;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToRuleEngineMsg&gt;&gt; toRuleEngine;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCoreMsg&gt;&gt; toTbCore;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToRuleEngineNotificationMsg&gt;&gt; toRuleEngineNotifications;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCoreNotificationMsg&gt;&gt; toTbCoreNotifications;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToEdgeMsg&gt;&gt; toEdge;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToEdgeNotificationMsg&gt;&gt; toEdgeNotifications;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToEdgeEventNotificationMsg&gt;&gt; toEdgeEvents;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToUsageStatsServiceMsg&gt;&gt; toUsageStats;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToVersionControlServiceMsg&gt;&gt; toVersionControl;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToHousekeeperServiceMsg&gt;&gt; toHousekeeper;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCalculatedFieldMsg&gt;&gt; toCalculatedFields;
    private TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCalculatedFieldNotificationMsg&gt;&gt; toCalculatedFieldNotifications;

	  
	public TbCoreQueueProducerProvider(TbCoreQueueFactory tbQueueProvider) {  
	    this.tbQueueProvider = tbQueueProvider;  
	}  
	  
	@PostConstruct  
	public void init() {  
	    this.toTbCore = tbQueueProvider.createTbCoreMsgProducer();  
	    this.toTransport = tbQueueProvider.createTransportNotificationsMsgProducer();  
	    this.toRuleEngine = tbQueueProvider.createRuleEngineMsgProducer();  
	    this.toRuleEngineNotifications = tbQueueProvider.createRuleEngineNotificationsMsgProducer();  
	    this.toTbCoreNotifications = tbQueueProvider.createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer();  
	    this.toUsageStats = tbQueueProvider.createToUsageStatsServiceMsgProducer();  
	    this.toVersionControl = tbQueueProvider.createVersionControlMsgProducer();  
	    this.toHousekeeper = tbQueueProvider.createHousekeeperMsgProducer();  
	    this.toEdge = tbQueueProvider.createEdgeMsgProducer();  
	    this.toEdgeNotifications = tbQueueProvider.createEdgeNotificationsMsgProducer();  
	    this.toEdgeEvents = tbQueueProvider.createEdgeEventMsgProducer();  
	    this.toCalculatedFields = tbQueueProvider.createToCalculatedFieldMsgProducer();  
	    this.toCalculatedFieldNotifications = tbQueueProvider.createToCalculatedFieldNotificationMsgProducer();  
	}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>如果是集群+Kafka<br>

<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
public TbQueueProducer&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCoreMsg&gt;&gt; createTbCoreMsgProducer() {
	TbKafkaProducerTemplate.TbKafkaProducerTemplateBuilder&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCoreMsg&gt;&gt; requestBuilder = TbKafkaProducerTemplate.builder();
	requestBuilder.settings(kafkaSettings);
	requestBuilder.clientId("tb-core-to-core-" + serviceInfoProvider.getServiceId());
	requestBuilder.defaultTopic(topicService.buildTopicName(coreSettings.getTopic()));
	requestBuilder.admin(coreAdmin);
	return requestBuilder.build();
}

<h4 id="各个对象的作用">各个对象的作用</h4>
<p>可以理解为每一个队列都有以下几个主要的对象, 以及他们的作用</p>
<div class="mermaid">flowchart LR

    subgraph 对象
        direction TB
        Settings["TbQueueCoreSettings &lt;br/&gt;配置对象: 配置定义的&lt;br/&gt;topic名,业务上有几个分区.."]
        TopicConfigs["TbKafkaTopicConfigs.coreConfigs&lt;br/&gt;Topic的配置参数,Admin使用这些参数来创建Topic,比如实际的分区数"]
        Admin["coreAdmin : TbKafkaAdmin&lt;br/&gt;持有 coreConfigs&lt;br/&gt;负责管理/确保: topic 存在"]
    end

    subgraph 执行时
        Producer["TbCoreMsgProducer&lt;br/&gt;TbKafkaProducerTemplate&lt;br/&gt;持有 KafkaProducer + admin&lt;br/&gt;负责生产消息"]
        Consumer["TbKafkaConsumerTemplate&lt;br/&gt;持有 KafkaConsumer + admin&lt;br/&gt;负责订阅消息"]
    end

    TopicConfigs --&gt; Admin
    Settings --&gt;|"topic 名"| Producer
    Settings --&gt;|"topic 名"| Consumer
    Admin --&gt;|"createTopicIfNotExists"| Producer
    Admin --&gt;|"createTopicIfNotExists"| Consumer
</div><h5 id="coresettings">coreSettings</h5>
<p>配置关于该队列的参数, topic 名称, 分区总数量</p>
<p>以 core 为例:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Lazy
@Data
@Component
public class TbQueueCoreSettings {
	
	//Kafka topic 名称
    @Value("${queue.core.topic}")
    private String topic;
    
	//OTA 升级消息, 走独立的topic, 防止大量固件推送消息阻塞设备状态/遥测处理
    @Value("${queue.core.ota.topic:tb_ota_package}")
    private String otaPackageTopic;
	
	//统计各租户的 API 调用量、设备数等
    @Value("${queue.core.usage-stats-topic:tb_usage_stats}")
    private String usageStatsTopic;

	//清理任务 topic
    @Value("${queue.core.housekeeper.topic:tb_housekeeper}")
    private String housekeeperTopic;
    @Value("${queue.core.housekeeper.reprocessing-topic:tb_housekeeper.reprocessing}")
    private String housekeeperReprocessingTopic;
    
    //Kafka 分区总数量
	//这是&nbsp;tb 的逻辑分区数,是HashPartitionService计算 理论上可以不一样, 但最好是一样的
    @Value("${queue.core.partitions}")
    private int partitions;
}
</code></pre>
<h5 id="coreconfigs">coreConfigs</h5>
<p>都是字符串, 再转为 <code>Map&lt;String, String&gt;</code>方便使用, 这里配置会被 xxxAdmin 使用在 Kafka Broker 上创建（注意只有该topic不存在才会创建, 所以已有的再修改不会生效的）</p>
<h5 id="kafka-的topic-参数说明">kafka 的topic 参数说明</h5>
<p>参考官方文档 - <a href="https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/topic-configs/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/topic-configs/</a></p>
<p>参数的说明:<br>
<a href="https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/topic-configs/#topicconfigs_retention.ms" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/topic-configs/#topicconfigs_retention.ms</a></p>
<ul>
<li>retention.ms = 604800000（7天）<br>
tb_core 消息是实时控制指令（设备属性更新、RPC 请求、会话超时等）, 不需要长期保留。7天是容灾窗口——如果 tb-core<br>
服务停机不超过7天重启, 未消费的消息仍可被处理；超过7天则认为消息已过期, 消费也无意义。</li>
<li>segment.bytes = 52428800（50MB）<br>
控制日志段滚动频率。50MB 是中等粒度：段太大导致 retention 清理粒度粗（只能整段删）, 段太小产生大量小文件。50MB 是官方推荐的中间值, 适合高吞吐控制类消息。</li>
<li>retention.bytes = 1048576000（~1GB）<br>
与 retention.ms 联合生效, 两者满足其一即触发清理。1GB 限制了单分区磁盘占用, 防止在消费速度跟不上时磁盘被打满。注意这是每个分区的限制, 由于 partitions=1, 整个 tb_core<br>
主题磁盘上限就是 1GB。</li>
<li>partitions = 1（物理分区数）</li>
</ul>
<p>这个是Topic 真正的Kafka的物理分区数, 需要与 TbQueueCoreSettings.partitions（默认10）区分：</p>
<pre><code>TbQueueCoreSettings.partitions = 10   → ThingsBoard 逻辑路由分区数
coreConfigs["partitions"] = 1         → Kafka Broker 物理分区数
</code></pre>
<p>TbKafkaTopicConfigs 存储着所有的 TopicConfigs:<br>
<code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.kafka.TbKafkaTopicConfigs</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Component

<h5 id="coreadmin">coreAdmin</h5>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.provider.KafkaMonolithQueueFactory#KafkaMonolithQueueFactory</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public KafkaMonolithQueueFactory(TopicService topicService,
								 TbKafkaSettings kafkaSettings,
								 KafkaAdmin kafkaAdmin,
								 TbServiceInfoProvider serviceInfoProvider,
								 TbQueueCoreSettings coreSettings,
								 TbQueueRuleEngineSettings ruleEngineSettings,
								 TbQueueTransportApiSettings transportApiSettings,
								 TbQueueTransportNotificationSettings transportNotificationSettings,
								 TbQueueRemoteJsInvokeSettings jsInvokeSettings,
								 TbQueueVersionControlSettings vcSettings,
								 TbQueueEdgeSettings edgeSettings,
								 TbQueueCalculatedFieldSettings calculatedFieldSettings,
								 TbKafkaConsumerStatsService consumerStatsService,
								 TbKafkaTopicConfigs kafkaTopicConfigs,
								 EdqsConfig edqsConfig,
								 TasksQueueConfig tasksQueueConfig) {

	....
	this.coreAdmin = new TbKafkaAdmin(kafkaSettings, kafkaTopicConfigs.getCoreConfigs());
	this.ruleEngineAdmin = new TbKafkaAdmin(kafkaSettings, kafkaTopicConfigs.getRuleEngineConfigs());
	
}
</code></pre>
<p>都是同一个 TbKafkaAdmin 对象不同实例进行管理, 但是每个实例的 kafkaSettings 和 kafkaTopicConfigs 不一样</p>
<blockquote>
<p>ThingsBoard 在首次 <code>createTopicIfNotExists()</code> 时用 coreConfigs 创建 Topic, 此后不会再更新已存在的 Topic 配置。所以：如果先启动 TB（自动建了 Topic）, 再改 thingsboard.yml 里的参数 → Kafka 上的 Topic 不会跟着变, 配置已经脱节</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="tbcorequeueproducerprovider-集群角色生产哪些消息">TbCoreQueueProducerProvider (集群角色生产哪些消息?)</h3>
<p>IDEA直接检索, 哪里调用该方法获取了生产者就知道了<br>
<code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.provider.TbCoreQueueProducerProvider#getTbCoreMsgProducer</code></p>
<h4 id="实体消息路由到集群内部">实体消息路由到集群内部</h4>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.service.queue.DefaultTbClusterService#pushMsgToCore(ToDeviceActorNotificationMsg, TbQueueCallback)</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
public void pushMsgToCore(TenantId tenantId, EntityId entityId, ToCoreMsg msg, TbQueueCallback callback) {
  // 用一致性哈希计算目标分区（哪个 Core 节点负责此 entityId）
  TopicPartitionInfo tpi = partitionService.resolve(ServiceType.TB_CORE, tenantId, entityId);
  // 发送到对应分区
  producerProvider.getTbCoreMsgProducer().send(tpi, new TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;&gt;(UUID.randomUUID(), msg), callback);
}
</code></pre>
<p>例如: 设备的 RPC 调用</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">
    @ApiOperation(value = "Delete persistent RPC", notes = "Deletes the persistent RPC request." + TENANT_AUTHORITY_PARAGRAPH)
    @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('TENANT_ADMIN')")
    @RequestMapping(value = "/persistent/{rpcId}", method = RequestMethod.DELETE)
    @ResponseBody
    public void deleteRpc(
            @Parameter(description = RPC_ID_PARAM_DESCRIPTION, required = true)
            @PathVariable(RPC_ID) String strRpc) throws ThingsboardException {
        checkParameter("RpcId", strRpc);
        RpcId rpcId = new RpcId(UUID.fromString(strRpc));
        Rpc rpc = checkRpcId(rpcId, Operation.DELETE);

        if (rpc != null) {
            if (rpc.getStatus().isPushDeleteNotificationToCore()) {
                RemoveRpcActorMsg removeMsg = new RemoveRpcActorMsg(getTenantId(), rpc.getDeviceId(), rpc.getUuidId());
                log.trace("[{}] Forwarding msg {} to queue actor!", rpc.getDeviceId(), rpc);
                tbClusterService.pushMsgToCore(removeMsg, null);
            }

            rpcService.deleteRpc(getTenantId(), rpcId);
            rpc.setStatus(RpcStatus.DELETED);

            TbMsg msg = TbMsg.newMsg()
                    .type(TbMsgType.RPC_DELETED)
                    .originator(rpc.getDeviceId())
                    .copyMetaData(TbMsgMetaData.EMPTY)
                    .data(JacksonUtil.toString(rpc))
                    .build();
            tbClusterService.pushMsgToRuleEngine(getTenantId(), rpc.getDeviceId(), msg, null);
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="transport-消息跨节点转发">Transport 消息跨节点转发</h4>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.common.transport.service.DefaultTransportService</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> protected void sendToDeviceActor(SessionInfoProto sessionInfo, TransportToDeviceActorMsg actorMsg, ...) {
      // 包装成 ToCoreMsg, 字段为 toDeviceActorMsg
      ToCoreMsg toCoreMsg = ToCoreMsg.newBuilder().setToDeviceActorMsg(actorMsg).build();
      sendToCore(getTenantId(sessionInfo), getDeviceId(sessionInfo), toCoreMsg, ...);
  }

  private void sendToCore(TenantId tenantId, EntityId entityId, ToCoreMsg msg, UUID routingKey, ...) {
      // 同样用 partitionService.resolve() 计算目标分区
      TopicPartitionInfo tpi = partitionService.resolve(ServiceType.TB_CORE, tenantId, entityId);
      // routingKey = deviceId.getId(), 保证同一设备消息总写入同一分区（保证有序）
      tbCoreMsgProducer.send(tpi, new TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;&gt;(routingKey, msg), wrappedCallback);
  }
</code></pre>
<h4 id="设备活动上线消息">设备活动/上线消息</h4>
<p>设备上线消息会经过 core queue</p>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.service.edge.rpc.processor.telemetry.BaseTelemetryProcessor</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java"> @PostConstruct
public void init() {
	tbCoreMsgProducer = producerProvider.getTbCoreMsgProducer();
}

public List&lt;ListenableFuture&lt;Void&gt;&gt; processTelemetryMsg(TenantId tenantId, EntityDataProto entityData) throws Exception {
	log.trace("[{}] processTelemetryMsg [{}]", tenantId, entityData);
	
			.............
			//根据租户 设备ID 推断指定的分区
				TopicPartitionInfo tpi = partitionService.resolve(ServiceType.TB_CORE, tenantId, deviceId);
			//设备 deviceActivityMsg 消息
				tbCoreMsgProducer.send(tpi, new TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;&gt;(deviceId.getId(),
						TransportProtos.ToCoreMsg.newBuilder().setDeviceActivityMsg(deviceActivityMsg).build()), null);
			}
		}
		if (entityData.hasAttributeDeleteMsg()) {
			result.add(processAttributeDeleteMsg(tenantId, entityId, entityData.getAttributeDeleteMsg(), entityData.getEntityType()));
		}
	} else {
		log.warn("[{}] Skipping telemetry update msg because entity doesn't exists on edge, {}", tenantId, entityData);
	}
	return result;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="defaulttbcoreconsumerservice-集群角色订阅消费消息">DefaultTbCoreConsumerService (集群角色订阅消费消息)</h3>
<p>注意: 序列化到 kafka 的消息定义, 在 <code>\thingsboard-mater\common\proto\src\main\proto\queue.proto</code>中<br>
[[Protocol buffers 协议]]</p>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.service.queue.DefaultTbCoreConsumerService#init</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostConstruct
public void init() {

    @PostConstruct
    public void init() {
        super.init("tb-core");
        this.deviceActivityEventsExecutor = MoreExecutors.listeningDecorator(Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(ThingsBoardThreadFactory.forName("tb-core-device-activity-events-executor")));
        
	    // 核心, 消费ToCoreMsg, 每个分区独立一个 Consumer 线程（当consumerPerPartition=true 时, 见 MainQueueConsumerManager）
        this.mainConsumer = MainQueueConsumerManager.&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToCoreMsg&gt;, QueueConfig&gt;builder()
                .queueKey(new QueueKey(ServiceType.TB_CORE)) // 标识这是 tb_core topic
                .config(QueueConfig.of(consumerPerPartition, pollInterval)) // 每25ms poll一次
                .msgPackProcessor(this::processMsgs)// 回调
                .consumerCreator((config, tpi) -&gt; queueFactory.createToCoreMsgConsumer())// 创建 KafkaConsumer
                .consumerExecutor(consumersExecutor)
                .scheduler(scheduler)
                .taskExecutor(mgmtExecutor)
                .build();
        // 统计用量 各租户的 API 调用量、设备数等
        this.usageStatsConsumer = QueueConsumerManager.&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToUsageStatsServiceMsg&gt;&gt;builder()
                .name("TB Usage Stats")
                .msgPackProcessor(this::processUsageStatsMsg)
                .pollInterval(pollInterval)
                .consumerCreator(queueFactory::createToUsageStatsServiceMsgConsumer)
                .consumerExecutor(consumersExecutor)
                .threadPrefix("usage-stats")
                .build();
        // 固件 OTA
        this.firmwareStatesConsumer = QueueConsumerManager.&lt;TbProtoQueueMsg&lt;ToOtaPackageStateServiceMsg&gt;&gt;builder()
                .name("TB Ota Package States")
                .msgPackProcessor(this::processFirmwareMsgs)
                .pollInterval(pollInterval)
                .consumerCreator(queueFactory::createToOtaPackageStateServiceMsgConsumer)
                .consumerExecutor(consumersExecutor)
                .threadPrefix("firmware")
                .build();
    }
</code></pre>
<h4 id="mainqueueconsumermanager">MainQueueConsumerManager</h4>
<p>类似组合模式 DefaultTbCoreConsumerService 委托给 <code>MainQueueConsumerManager</code> 它是真正使用线程轮询拉取消息的</p>
<p>它的核心作用是: 根据当前节点负责的分区集合，动态创建/销毁 Kafka Consumer 线程。</p>
<div class="mermaid"> flowchart TD
      MCM["MainQueueConsumerManager"]
      MCM --&gt;|"consumerPerPartition=true"| CPP["ConsumerPerPartitionWrapper&lt;br/&gt;Map&amp;lt;TopicPartitionInfo, ConsumerTask&amp;gt;&lt;br/&gt;每个分区 = 1个KafkaConsumer + 1个线程"]
      MCM --&gt;|"consumerPerPartition=false"| SC["SingleConsumerWrapper&lt;br/&gt;全部分区 = 1个KafkaConsumer + 1个线程&lt;br/&gt;consumer.subscribe(allPartitions)"]
</div><p>分区更改时...</p>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.service.queue.DefaultTbCoreConsumerService#onTbApplicationEvent</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override  
protected void onTbApplicationEvent(PartitionChangeEvent event) {  
    log.debug("Subscribing to partitions: {}", event.getCorePartitions());  
    //分区更改时, 停掉或者启动消费线程
    mainConsumer.update(event.getCorePartitions());  
    
    usageStatsConsumer.subscribe(event.getCorePartitions()  
            .stream()  
            .map(tpi -&gt; tpi.withTopic(usageStatsConsumer.getConsumer().getTopic()))  
            .collect(Collectors.toSet()));  
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>PartitionChangeEvent 事件, 从哪里来? 见  HashPartitionService 计算完后发布的事件</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="最后-总结一下">最后 总结一下</h3>
<p>回来解决: 整体项目, 有哪些队列通道(Topic),  生产者, 消费者?</p>
<div class="mermaid"> flowchart LR                                                                                                                                                                 
      subgraph 配置                                                                                                                                                          
          YML["thingsboard.yml&lt;br/&gt;queue.* 配置项"]
          ENV["环境变量&lt;br/&gt;TB_QUEUE_CORE_TOPIC 等"]
          Settings["TbQueueCoreSettings&lt;br/&gt;TbQueueRuleEngineSettings&lt;br/&gt;TbQueueTransportApiSettings"]
          YML --&gt; Settings
          ENV --&gt; Settings
      end

      subgraph 创建工厂

  Factory["KafkaMonolithQueueFactory&lt;br/&gt;KafkaTbCoreQueueFactory&lt;br/&gt;KafkaTbRuleEngineQueueFactory&lt;br/&gt;KafkaTbTransportQueueFactory&lt;br/&gt;KafkaTbVersionControlQueueFactory 再细化一点(xxxSettings,xxxConfigs,xxxAdmin)"]
      end

      subgraph 生产提供者
          Provider["TbCoreQueueProducerProvider&lt;br/&gt;TbRuleEngineProducerProvider&lt;br/&gt;TbTransportQueueProducerProvider&lt;br/&gt;TbVersionControlProducerProvider"]
      end

      subgraph 消费服务
          Consumer["DefaultTbCoreConsumerService&lt;br/&gt;DefaultTbRuleEngineConsumerService&lt;br/&gt;DefaultTbEdgeConsumerService&lt;br/&gt;DefaultTbCalculatedFieldConsumerService&lt;br/&gt;Defaul
  tClusterVersionControlService&lt;br/&gt;EdqsProcessor"]
      end

      Settings --&gt; Factory
      Factory --&gt; Provider
      Factory --&gt; Consumer
</div><table>

<h2 id="三-hashpartitionservice-队列分区计算">三. HashPartitionService 队列分区计算</h2>
<h3 id="关键的属性">关键的属性</h3>
<p>HashPartitionService有 一堆的容器集合字段</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>字段</th>
<th>类型</th>
<th>存储</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>myPartitions</td>
<td>ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, List<integer>&gt;</integer></td>
<td>当前节点负责的分区编号列表, key 是队列标识, value 是分区下标</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>partitionTopicsMap</td>
<td>ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, String&gt;</td>
<td>每个队列对应的 Kafka topic 名</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>partitionSizesMap</td>
<td>ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, Integer&gt;</td>
<td>每个队列的总分区数</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>queueConfigs</td>
<td>ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, QueueConfig&gt;</td>
<td>规则引擎队列的详细配置（提交策略等）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tenantRoutingInfoMap</td>
<td>ConcurrentMap&lt;TenantId, TenantRoutingInfo&gt;</td>
<td>租户的路由信息缓存（决定租户走哪个规则引擎实例）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>currentOtherServices</td>
<td>List<serviceinfo></serviceinfo></td>
<td>当前已知的其他集群节点列表</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tbTransportServicesByType</td>
<td>Map&lt;String, List<serviceinfo>&gt;</serviceinfo></td>
<td>按传输类型分组的 Transport 节点列表</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>responsibleServices</td>
<td>Map&lt;TenantProfileId, List<serviceinfo>&gt;</serviceinfo></td>
<td>按租户 Profile 分组的责任节点, 用于隔离租户流量</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>hashFunction</td>
<td>HashFunction</td>
<td>Guava 哈希函数实例, 用于计算 entityId 落在哪个分区</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p>QueueKey&nbsp;是核心索引, 结构为&nbsp;(ServiceType, tenantId, queueName), 三者组合唯一确定一条队列, 所有 Map 均以它为 key。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="计算的逻辑">计算的逻辑</h3>
<p><code>org.thingsboard.server.queue.discovery.HashPartitionService#recalculatePartitions</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Override
    public synchronized void recalculatePartitions(ServiceInfo currentService, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; otherServices) {
        log.info("Recalculating partitions");
        tbTransportServicesByType.clear();
        logServiceInfo(currentService);
        otherServices.forEach(this::logServiceInfo);

        // queueServicesMap: 每个队列 -&gt; 集群中所有能处理该队列的节点列表
        // responsibleServices: 租户 Profile -&gt; 被专属指定负责该 Profile 的规则引擎节点（租户隔离用）
        Map&lt;QueueKey, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; queueServicesMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        Map&lt;TenantProfileId, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; responsibleServices = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        addNode(currentService, queueServicesMap, responsibleServices);
        for (ServiceInfo other : otherServices) {
            addNode(other, queueServicesMap, responsibleServices);
        }
        // 按 serviceId 排序：所有节点独立计算时用相同顺序，保证结果一致无需协商
        queueServicesMap.values().forEach(list -&gt; list.sort(Comparator.comparing(ServiceInfo::getServiceId)));
        responsibleServices.values().forEach(list -&gt; list.sort(Comparator.comparing(ServiceInfo::getServiceId)));

        // newPartitions: 本次计算出的当前节点负责的分区编号列表，key=队列，value=分区下标列表
        final ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, List&lt;Integer&gt;&gt; newPartitions = new ConcurrentHashMap&lt;&gt;();
        partitionSizesMap.forEach((queueKey, size) -&gt; {
            for (int i = 0; i &lt; size; i++) {
                try {
                    List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt; services = resolveByPartitionIdx(queueServicesMap.get(queueKey), queueKey, i, responsibleServices);
                    log.trace("Server responsible for {}[{}] - {}", queueKey, i, services);
                    if (services.contains(currentService)) {
                        newPartitions.computeIfAbsent(queueKey, key -&gt; new ArrayList&lt;&gt;()).add(i);
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    log.warn("Failed to resolve server responsible for {}[{}]", queueKey, i, e);
                }
            }
        });
        this.responsibleServices = responsibleServices;

        // oldPartitions: 上一次的分区快照，用于差量对比
        final ConcurrentMap&lt;QueueKey, List&lt;Integer&gt;&gt; oldPartitions = myPartitions;
        myPartitions = newPartitions;

        // changedPartitionsMap: 需要通知的变更队列 -&gt; 新分区集合（空集合表示移除）
        // oldPartitionsMap: 对应的旧分区集合，一并传入事件供监听方使用
        Map&lt;QueueKey, Set&lt;TopicPartitionInfo&gt;&gt; changedPartitionsMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        Map&lt;QueueKey, Set&lt;TopicPartitionInfo&gt;&gt; oldPartitionsMap = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();

        // removed: 旧分区中存在、新分区中不存在的队列（当前节点不再负责）
        Set&lt;QueueKey&gt; removed = new HashSet&lt;&gt;();
        oldPartitions.forEach((queueKey, partitions) -&gt; {
            if (!newPartitions.containsKey(queueKey)) {
                removed.add(queueKey);
            }
        });
        // 规则引擎租户队列：partitionSizesMap 中有定义但新分区无分配，也视为移除
        if (serviceInfoProvider.isService(ServiceType.TB_RULE_ENGINE)) {
            partitionSizesMap.keySet().stream()
                    .filter(queueKey -&gt; queueKey.getType() == ServiceType.TB_RULE_ENGINE &amp;&amp;
                                        !queueKey.getTenantId().isSysTenantId() &amp;&amp;
                                        !newPartitions.containsKey(queueKey))
                    .forEach(removed::add);
        }
        // 移除的队列写入空集合，消费者收到后停止订阅
        removed.forEach(queueKey -&gt; {
            changedPartitionsMap.put(queueKey, Collections.emptySet());
        });

        myPartitions.forEach((queueKey, partitions) -&gt; {
            if (!partitions.equals(oldPartitions.get(queueKey))) {
                changedPartitionsMap.put(queueKey, toTpiList(queueKey, partitions));
                oldPartitionsMap.put(queueKey, toTpiList(queueKey, oldPartitions.get(queueKey)));
            }
        });
        if (!changedPartitionsMap.isEmpty()) {
            changedPartitionsMap.entrySet().stream()
                    .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(entry -&gt; entry.getKey().getType(), Collectors.toMap(Map.Entry::getKey, Map.Entry::getValue)))
                    .forEach((serviceType, partitionsMap) -&gt; {
	                    // 发布 PartitionChangeEvent 事件, 当前节点负责的分区发生变化时发布, 按 ServiceType 分组
                        publishPartitionChangeEvent(serviceType, partitionsMap, oldPartitionsMap);
                    });
        }

        if (currentOtherServices == null) {
            // 首次计算，无旧快照，不发布拓扑变化事件
            currentOtherServices = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;(otherServices);
        } else {
            // changes: 本次与上次相比，节点列表发生变化的 QueueKey 集合
            Set&lt;QueueKey&gt; changes = new HashSet&lt;&gt;();
            Map&lt;QueueKey, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; currentMap = getServiceKeyListMap(currentOtherServices);
            Map&lt;QueueKey, List&lt;ServiceInfo&gt;&gt; newMap = getServiceKeyListMap(otherServices);
            currentOtherServices = otherServices;
            currentMap.forEach((key, list) -&gt; {
                if (!list.equals(newMap.get(key))) {
                    changes.add(key);
                }
            });
            // newMap 中剩余的 key 是本次新增的队列
            currentMap.keySet().forEach(newMap::remove);
            changes.addAll(newMap.keySet());
            if (!changes.isEmpty()) {
	            // 发布 ClusterTopologyChangeEvent 事件: 集群节点组成变化时发布, 携带受影响的&nbsp;`QueueKey`&nbsp;集合
                applicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(new ClusterTopologyChangeEvent(this, changes));
                responsibleServices.forEach((profileId, serviceInfos) -&gt; {
                    if (profileId != null) {
                        log.info("Servers responsible for tenant profile {}: {}", profileId, toServiceIds(serviceInfos));
                    } else {
                        log.info("Servers responsible for system queues: {}", toServiceIds(serviceInfos));
                    }
                });
            }
        }
		// 发布 ServiceListChangedEvent 事件, 每次重算后无条件发布，携带最新全量服务节点列表，不做差量判断
        applicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(new ServiceListChangedEvent(otherServices, currentService));
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="应用事件">应用事件</h3>
<p>会发布三个应用事件</p>
<ol>
<li>PartitionChangeEvent 事件: 当前节点负责的分区发生变化时发布, 按 ServiceType 分组</li>
<li>ClusterTopologyChangeEvent 事件: 集群节点组成变化时发布, 携带受影响的&nbsp;<code>QueueKey</code>&nbsp;集合</li>
<li>ServiceListChangedEvent 事件: 每次重算后无条件发布，携带最新全量服务节点列表</li>
</ol>


</div>
